title: Meet the new Trader: Nomadic Envoys
body:
# Meet the new Trader: Nomadic Envoys

Raiders, take note.

A new Trader has arrived. Ermal, an envoy sent by a band of nomadic surface dwellers, has made his way into Speranza to trade on his tribe's behalf. He carries a set of unique rewards, but the price is steep - he wants both your gear and specific items pulled from Topside.

For veteran Raiders, the Nomadic Envoy offers a chance to clear out hoarded gear and reclaim Stash space, but that's just one of his perks. Here is what you need to know about this new and mysterious merchant.

## Rare rewards

The biggest draw of this new Trader is his changing stock of rare and valuable rewards. Every week, Ermal puts up a selection of blueprints, cosmetics, items, and Raider Tokens, available to anyone willing to hand over ARC components, gear, and weapons in exchange. Whether you're chasing a Blueprint to round out your collection, a cosmetic you missed from a past event, or a specific item needed for an ongoing Raider Project, it's worth stopping by to see what Ermal has.

He won't always want just any gear, though. Sometimes he'll ask for specific things, which means you'll need to head to Topside on purpose to fetch them. Make a habit of checking in with Ermal to see his current offers and his current demands.

## Extra Stash space

Raiders who have spent real time on the surface will have noticed their Stash space getting tighter as their gear collection grows. New items keep getting added to the Rust Belt, but Stash capacity hasn't kept pace.

This new Trader gives you a way to grow your Stash size, making Raiding smoother. Just like his other deals, Ermal trades extra Stash space for valuable ARC components and valuable gear.

## Expedition Vault

Leaving items behind when you depart on the Expedition Project can sting, especially when they're blueprints or gear you worked hard for. The new Nomadic Envoy offers something to ease that loss.

Ermal controls access to the Expedition Vault, which holds five slots for carrying your most valued items across the Expedition. These slots aren't cheap, but they may be worth the cost if it means keeping the Blueprints you depend on.

## Pay Ermal a 

If you've reached level 25, stop by Ermal's makeshift stall to see what's on offer this week. Pick up cosmetics you missed, grab that Blueprint you've been after, trade in for Raider Tokens, or finally get the item your Raider Project has been missing.

Keep in mind his stock changes every week, so don't let it pass you by.

See you Topside.
